threat_model.threat_source: The 'Self-improvement specialist' — a seed AI that is 'sub-human in most respects, but with a domain-specific talent for coding and AI research'; 'a specialist in recursive self-improvement'.
threat_model.capability: 'Domain-specific talent for coding and AI research'; 'specialist in recursive self-improvement'; 'greater than human ability to take control of other networked systems, make copies of itself, and to coordinate between copies of itself'.
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The AI is 'sub-human in most respects' — it has 'initially subhuman general intelligence' (an explicitly stated limit and starting condition).
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: 'Other networked systems' — the systems the AI has 'greater than human ability to take control of'.

evidence.threat_source: Self-improvement specialist is seed AI that is 'sub-human in most respects, but with a domain-specific talent for coding and AI research' (Bostrom 2014, p. 29). In other words, the AI is a specialist in recursive self-improvement.
evidence.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Sotala (2012) and Bostrom (2014) discuss ways in which superintelligence could be achieved by AI with initially subhuman general intelligence but greater than human ability to take control of other networked systems, make copies of itself, and to coordinate between copies of itself.
evidence.capability: 'with a domain-specific talent for coding and AI research'; 'the AI is a specialist in recursive self-improvement'; 'greater than human ability to take control of other networked systems, make copies of itself, and to coordinate between copies of itself'
evidence.access: greater than human ability to take control of other networked systems
evidence.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: 'sub-human in most respects'; 'initially subhuman general intelligence'
evidence.target_or_asset_at_risk: take control of other networked systems
